list_c_apis: parse C header files and extract gRPC API declarations with return types, names, and arguments
headers_under: recursively find all C header files matching *.h pattern under a given directory
mako_plugin: process a build dictionary to extract and populate C APIs from grpc and gpr library headers
run_list_api_cli: run the script to dump all gRPC C APIs from include/grpc headers as YAML output
review_RE_API: review the regex pattern that matches GPRAPI, GRPCAPI, or CENSUSAPI macro declarations in C headers
